Pass 2: confirmed; stray chevron marks in the window replaced by goods (Street View 2024).

21643636.note: Husova 3: white baroque house, horizontally rusticated ground floor, brown wooden shop door; wrought-iron hanging sign of Egoist Royal Parfums at the north end. Pass 2: confirmed in the 21643644_48 pair (Street View 2019).

21646104.note: Jilská 2 (U Vejvodů): low ochre house, ground floor of rough brown-grey rubble under a dressed ledge, arched glazed wooden door at 4–6 m in a dressed stone surround, green board above, tall white banner; then a cream pilaster and a maroon-framed shopfront (8–15 m) of a tall cream neo-renaissance house. Pass 2: rubble redrawn as small irregular stones; house rustic none (rubble had covered all floors); duplicate board removed (Street View 2024).

21643628.note: Husova 4a / Jilská 3: the Husova fronts are a white garden wall about 3.5 m high with a red-tiled coping and blind round arches, a restaurant terrace under Staropramen umbrellas in front; behind the corner a sand-coloured 3-storey house with dormers and a round-arched ground-floor arcade. Pass 2: confirmed; the model still builds a full white house on these edges (Street View 2019).

21644691.note: Jilská 1: one RÚIAN building of several houses: warm ochre house with dark shopfronts under the HAVLÍKOVA PŘÍRODNÍ APOTÉKA board; plain front on Jilská; pale ochre 3-storey house with red dormers and barred windows; grey-beige gabled house with white strapwork stucco; cream house with a lantern. Pass 2: edge 4 warmer, edge 7 rustic none (ornate drew a grey base), edge 8 creamier (Street View 2019, 2024).

21645388.note: Vejvodova 8: cream house seen edge-on with a tall vertical white hanging banner reading HOTEL, letters stacked; facade detail not readable from this camera (Street View 2019).

21643644.note: Husova 5: white baroque palace, white banded ground floor, tall brown wooden windows in stucco surrounds with hoods, wall lantern and a carved stone portal with a sculpted head. Pass 2: rustic changed from ornate to banded because ornate drew a grey stone base the photo does not have; ground floor two tall windows and the portal door (Street View 2019).

21649251.note: Vejvodova 4/6: pale greenish-white classical house, acanthus consoles under window hoods, round-arched ground-floor openings with an oak door under a sunburst fanlight; next door a cream house with a wooden double door and lantern. Pass 2: confidence raised so the colour applies; the model showed this house brownish-pink, which no photo supports (Street View 2019).

21644616.note: Jilská 4 (U Vejvodů): saturated ochre house, two storeys and a stepped gable, brown sandstone window surrounds with red-brown frames. Pass 2: arcade redrawn as a deep round arch on stacked stone corbels with the green board and red-framed glazed door behind; canopy redrawn as a red pantile roof over the dark "U VEJVODŮ" fascia and rough stone arch; floors 2, darker trim; duplicate signs removed (Street View 2024).

21643211.note: Smetanovo nábřeží side of Karlova 189/2: weathered grey-beige baroque front. Tall ground-floor windows in stone frames between rusticated pilaster strips, heavily tagged, wall lantern. Upper floors alternate framed windows and blank recessed panels. (Street View 2025)

46669388.note: Staroměstská mostecká věž: dark weathered sandstone Gothic tower; east face with the pointed bridge gate arch, sculpture gallery and tracery above, corner turrets with spires. Marks partly fall on open terrace. (Street View 2014)

21643202.note: Anenská, three fronts. Edge 1 (no. 5): plain pale cream, barred wooden door in red-brown stone frame, recessed door under bronze UNITARIA letters. Edge 2: greige, pedimented windows, iron balcony on a carved console at left, white-framed shops Cosmetics and Manicure & Pedicure. Edge 3: cream, pediments, U ZÁBRADLÍ and COFFEE AND WINE banners by a white door. (Street View 2024)

21643245.note: Křižovnické náměstí 193/2 by the bridge tower: very pale cream four-storey house, pedimented windows, dormers on a pitched roof, ground floor of dark-framed shop windows and doors. Seen from a distance; signs unreadable. (Street View 2014)

43628966.note: Klementinum, portico of sv. Salvátor on Křižovnické náměstí: open arcade of grey sandstone piers on tall pedestals with round arches and carved capitals; a walk-through porch, not a wall. (Street View 2024)

21643300.note: Novotného lávka: seen edge-on behind a van. Cream upper floor with a tall arched window and part of a big red letter sign outlined in blue (only 'KA' visible), dark brown brick ground floor with downpipes. (Street View 2024)

21644446.note: Betlémská 331/1 / Smetanovo nábř. 8: mint-green three-storey corner house, banded ground floor on a tall plinth with barred cellar windows. Betlémská front: two arched windows under grey ETCETERA ART letters, four more, a wall lantern, a round-arched stone portal with a brown panelled door, plates 331 and 1, a balcony on consoles above. River side: a first-floor balcony. East end (edge 7): cream with an ochre string course. New (Street View 2024-2025)
